newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Kilroy Realty started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Kilroy Realty started.

text.p: -- Smith Barney analyst David Sherman said he initiated coverage of Kilroy Realty Corp with an outperform rating.
-- estimated earnings of $1.97 per share for 1997, and $2.25 for 1998.
-- cited company's "50-year track record of developing properties in Los Angeles," and its "$117 million war chest that should help jump start acquisitions."
-- set 12-month price target of $28.50. Shares closed Wednesday at 26-1/4.
